trap.uz: 'I very like it' NOTO'G'RI — 'I like it very much'.
Urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda: IN-teresting. 'I am interesting' = 'men qiziqarli odamman'; 'men qiziqyapman' = 'I am interested'.
'I am boring' = 'men zerikarliman'; 'men zerikyapman' = 'I am bored'.
'funny' = kulgili; 'fun' = zavqli. 'It was fun' ≠ 'It was funny'.
